text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(My body's holding up! My legs are holding up!
My head has never been this clear!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(That's why I can tell!
How hard that "one last step to catch up" really is!
And the difference in our strength...!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(—Still, I want to win! That's why I want to beat them!
Spe-chan! And King-chan too—!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(...At that moment,
I felt like my eyes met Sei-chan's for a split second.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
O-Oooo, ooooooh, oooooooooooh!
Like I'd ever loooooooose!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I ran with all my might!
I raced with everything I had!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Even so, losing...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky finishes 1st!
It's Seiun Skyyyyy—!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Argh, my whole body is shaking...!
Seriously, everyone is... so strong...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (My face is burning hot. Even deep in my eyes, it burns. Even the sweat tracing down the bridge of my nose feels scorching hot—)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (—I found myself thinking once more that I want to win next time.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh! Congrats,
Seiun Skyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...You're so amazing, Sei-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And Tsuru-chan has grown so much too...!
I'm sure she kept working super hard after that...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She's so amazing...! She's trying so hard...!
I have to fire myself up even more...!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Are you heading home already?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, hurry up and get
to the winner's circle already.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...That said, even angler Sei-chan is having trouble
deciding what tackle to use next~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Not everything went according to expectations today, either.
It looks like the same trick won't work twice."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If there's a miscalculation—
—then we need to start making corrections.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-saaan.
I'm gonna give it a quick spritz with cooling spray, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, —yes!
I'd be glad to!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah!?
Did I do it again... I'm so sorry! Um...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It just hasn't really sunk in yet.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "Even after running the whole Kikuka-sho... you're both standing so firmly and able to converse like this."
choice_data_list: It just shows how much stronger you've become.
It just shows how much stronger you've become.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ......Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ……"Absolute", right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...So, I was able to run in the Triple Crown races after all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Trainer. You're up right after me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I want to run much, much more.
To see just how far the me who ran today can go next time.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race really drove it home for me.
Just how strong my generation is. But—"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"—Right now, I just desperately want to believe
that the day might come when I can surpass my peers!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That is why I want to head for
the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If you want to become an Umamusume who can beat any opponent,
you've got to run in the Tenno Sho (Spring), just like President Rudolf did!
choice_data_list: So that's the challenge you want to take on, Tsuyoshi?
So you want to take on that challenge, Tsuyoshi?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To be honest, the distance might pose some difficulties. But she is the one who can overcome that.
choice_data_list: I bet Tsuyoshi could pull it off
I bet Tsuyoshi could pull it off, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next goal was decided
to be the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
